scope: 75-second shallow sample, whole main/reef swimmer asset family
animalAssets: Project-authored continuous bodies and curved complete fins, shared material response and individual spine waves. Not scans or calibrated measurements. No external photos or meshes copied into these new fish.
speciesRules: Retain original identity, species and total-length units.
Caranx ignobilis has a steep head and no dark gill-cover spot; that marking is restricted to the separate bigeye-trevally configuration.

Moorish idol, blue tang, yellow tang and unidentified reef fish now use authored complete forms in the same main-swimmer family. Barramundi, turtles, sharks, rays, cephalopods and benthic families retain their previous geometry. Unidentified reef fish stays unidentified; no species is inferred from the former source mesh.
defaultReplacements: Principal CC0 specimen fish and existing authored reef swimmers replaced in the default sample by this authored family. Original source files and licences retained as historical assets; no longer used for principal shoal rendering.
coralAssets: Two Smithsonian CC0 whole-branching specimens; complete formosa, fixed lower support crop on secale, uniformly scaled. Dry specimen geometry with authored colour, not a live-tissue scan.
limitations: Fin/body anatomy and colouring remain authored and simplified. Cohesive does not mean documentary realism or full ecosystem simulation. Existing CC BY and CC BY-NC obligations remain separate.
